description: WF-SURFACE-SSOT-001 — the reviewed, single-source-of-truth declaration of the WebFlash deploy surface. Every count/set guard in the test suites derives its expectations from this file via __tests__/helpers/expected-surface.js: total build count, per-channel counts, the stable and preview config sets, the expected .bin/.meta.json filenames (from the canonical Sense360-<config_string>-v<version>-<channel>.bin convention), and the firmware-N.json index bound (count - 1). The tests compare REALITY (manifest.json, firmware/configurations/ on disk, firmware-N.json, kits.json cross-checks) against this fixture exactly — missing AND unexpected entries both fail — so a drifted fixture cannot auto-pass.
review_rule: A surface change (import, retirement, promotion, version bump) must edit this file in the SAME PR that changes the surface, and the two are reviewed together. See docs/expected-surface-fixture.md (archived; see docs/archive-index.md).
filename_convention: Sense360-<config_string>-v<version>-<channel>.bin with a sibling <name>.meta.json sidecar. Application builds live under firmware/configurations/; the Rescue artifact lives under firmware/rescue/ and has no sidecar requirement.

retired.reason: Superseded by the v1.0.10-preview review build (SENSE360-REVIEW-RELEASE-001, issue #604). Retired BEFORE the import because prune_superseded_configurations (scripts/import-firmware-sources.py) only removes a superseded build on the SAME channel: v1.0.9 published as a stable-named binary while v1.0.10 publishes as preview, so the importer would have left two Ceiling-POE-AirIQ-RoomIQ builds in manifest.json and the config would have had no unambiguous served review build.
retired.note: A clean supersession, NOT a for-cause delisting: the v1.0.9 binary was correctly signed and served, so its source entry is removed outright (the established supersession pattern of #553 and the Ceiling-POE-RoomIQ v1.0.0-preview retirement) rather than moved to the delisted_sources register, which stays reserved for the pre-credential-gate artifacts that must never reappear. The CONFIG returns in the active surface at v1.0.10 on the preview channel; only this v1.0.9 stable-named ARTIFACT is retired. The 2026-07-28 presentation demotion (SENSE360-CANONICALISATION-001) that served this stable-named binary on the preview channel retires with it: v1.0.10 is published preview, so it needs no channel_presentation override.
